text: Alarm management follows EEMUA 191 and IEC 62682 / ISA-18.2, as accepted in TQ-026 for the TCS alarms: one plant alarm philosophy for the DCS, TCS and package alarms (ALP-EPC-00000-IC-RPT-0001); an alarm is configured only if it requires an operator action, has a documented cause, consequence, corrective action and response time (rationalisation), and has a priority.
